Title: Items that break when a subscription moves to another Entra tenant
Recommendation: Required reading before an M&A or tenant-to-tenant move: identities, Key Vaults, RBAC and Entra-integrated services must be prepared.
Detail: Managed identity (4), RBAC (3), Azure DevOps (2), Entra authentication (1), Key Vault (1), ...

Title: Resources whose type cannot be moved to another subscription
Recommendation: These resources must be redeployed (not moved) when you restructure subscriptions - plan the rebuild effort.

Title: Resources on services or features that are already retired
Recommendation: Migrate these resources first - retired features lose support and SLA and can stop working at any time.
Detail: Application Gateway v1 (Standard/WAF) (1), Basic Load Balancer (1), Basic SKU public IP addresses (1), Log Analytics agent (MMA/OMS) (1), SQL Server out of extended support (SQL on Azure VM) (1), ...

Title: Non-Microsoft apps with critical API permissions
Recommendation: Review apps that can read all mail, change the directory or grant themselves permissions.

Title: Guest accounts with privileged Azure roles (Owner, Contributor, UAA)
Recommendation: Review external accounts with write or access-management rights; prefer PIM with approval.

Title: Guest accounts with Entra directory roles
Recommendation: External accounts should not hold directory roles - use dedicated member admin accounts.

Title: Expired app secrets or certificates
Recommendation: Remove expired credentials and check the apps still work; move to certificates or workload identity federation.

Title: Role assignments of deleted identities (orphaned RBAC)
Recommendation: Remove orphaned assignments - they clutter access reviews and complicate tenant moves.

Title: Public Azure DevOps projects
Recommendation: Make the projects private unless they are meant to be public: anyone can read the code, pipelines and work items of a public project.

Title: NSG rules expose x-389e09138c ports to the Internet
Recommendation: Close RDP/SSH/database ports to the Internet; use Azure Bastion, VPN or just-in-time access.

Title: Orphaned or unused resources
Recommendation: Delete or deallocate what is not needed - less cost and less to migrate.
Detail: 30.25 cost in the period; Unused public IP (2), Empty App Service plan (1), Empty availability set (1), Empty resource group (1), Idle load balancer (1), Orphaned NIC (1), ...

Title: Azure DevOps users with a Basic (or Basic + Test Plans) license and no sign-in for 90 days
Recommendation: Change them to Stakeholder or remove them: beyond the free users, these licenses are billed every month.

Title: Azure Advisor cost recommendations
Recommendation: Review right-sizing, reservations and shutdown recommendations.

Title: Resources non-compliant with Azure Policy
Recommendation: Remediate or exempt; top assignments by non-compliance are in policyAssignments.csv.

Title: Policy exemptions expired or expiring within 30 days
Recommendation: Renew or remove exemptions; expired exemptions hide nothing but clutter compliance data.

Title: Resources that reference resources in other resource groups or subscriptions
Recommendation: Dependent resources must move together (same move operation) - group them into migration waves.

Title: Azure Policy restricts regions, resource types or VM sizes
Recommendation: Check the target regions and SKUs of the migration against these policies (or plan exemptions).
Detail: Allowed locations: westeurope, northeurope | Allowed virtual machine size SKUs: Standard_D4s_v5, Standard_B2s

Title: VMs not protected by Azure Backup
Recommendation: Protect workloads before migration waves and verify restore points exist.

Title: Overlapping VNet address spaces
Recommendation: Overlapping ranges prevent peering and hybrid connectivity - re-address before consolidating networks.

Title: References to resources that no longer exist
Recommendation: Clean up dangling references before moving resources; they often make move validation fail.

Title: Azure DevOps projects that still use TFVC (Team Foundation Version Control)
Recommendation: Plan the move to Git: decide which branches and how much history to keep and remove large binaries first. The Azure DevOps import takes one branch with up to 180 days of history.

Title: Self-hosted Azure DevOps agents that are offline or on agent version 2
Recommendation: Remove agents whose machines are gone and upgrade old agents to the current version.

Title: Resources affected by retirements in the next 12 months
Recommendation: Plan and budget the upgrades now; many of these are forced migrations with fixed dates.
Detail: Automation runtimes Python 2.7/3.8 and PowerShell 7.1/7.2 2026-09-30 (2), General-purpose v1 and x-3f4a1e52ca Blob storage accounts 2026-10-13 (1), Storage classic metrics 2026-12-31 (1)

Title: Storage accounts that allow anonymous blob access
Recommendation: Set AllowBlobPublicAccess to false unless a public container is really needed.

Title: Personal Microsoft accounts and guests in Azure DevOps organizations
Recommendation: Review them: personal Microsoft accounts are outside your Entra ID controls (MFA, Conditional Access, offboarding).

Title: Services accepting TLS older than 1.2
Recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.2+ (storage, SQL, App Service); TLS 1.0/1.1 is being retired across Azure.

Title: Azure DevOps service connections that sign in with a service principal secret
Recommendation: Convert them to workload identity federation: there is no secret to leak, expire or renew.

Title: NSG rules allow other inbound traffic from the Internet
Recommendation: Confirm these rules are intended (web front ends) and protected by a WAF/firewall.

Title: Custom roles with wildcard (*) actions
Recommendation: Replace wildcards with explicit actions to follow least privilege.

Title: App secrets or certificates expiring within 30 days
Recommendation: Renew before expiry to avoid outages; automate rotation (Key Vault) where possible.

Title: Subscriptions without activity log export
Recommendation: Export the activity log of every subscription to a central Log Analytics workspace.

Title: Web apps that allow HTTP or unencrypted FTP
Recommendation: Enable HTTPS only and set FTP to FTPS only or disabled.

Title: App registrations without owners
Recommendation: Assign at least two owners so every app has an accountable team.

Title: Key Vaults without purge protection
Recommendation: Enable purge protection so deleted keys and secrets cannot be destroyed during the retention period.

Title: Resources without any tags
Recommendation: Tag owner, application and cost center - it speeds up migration planning and cost allocation.

Title: Custom policy definitions or initiatives that are not assigned
Recommendation: Remove unused custom definitions to simplify governance.

Title: Policy assignments in DoNotEnforce mode
Recommendation: Decide whether these should be enforced.

Title: Classic Azure DevOps pipelines (classic build and release pipelines)
Recommendation: Plan their move to YAML pipelines: classic pipelines are not versioned with the code and take more work to migrate.

Title: x-389e09138c locks (block moves and deletions)
Recommendation: Plan to remove and re-apply locks around move operations.

Title: Resources affected by later announced retirements
Recommendation: Include these in the modernization roadmap.

Title: Resources without diagnostic settings
Recommendation: Send logs and metrics of important resources to Log Analytics (use Azure Policy to enforce it).

Title: Guest invitations never accepted
Recommendation: Remove pending guest invitations that are no longer needed.
